errors.text_span: X轴显示五个维度：第一维度、第二维度、第三维度、第四维度和第五维度，以及第六维度
errors.evidence: The phrasing "五个维度...以及第六维度" (five dimensions... and the sixth dimension) is awkward. It would be clearer to state "六个维度" (six dimensions) and then list them.

errors.text_span: 数值范围从1到6，刻度间隔为1
errors.evidence: The x-axis is categorical, displaying six distinct labels ('第一维度', '第二维度', etc.). It is not a numerical axis with a range and interval.
The description incorrectly assigns the value -1.310 to the blue line ('美国学者') at '第一维度'. The correct value shown on the chart is 1.310.
The description incorrectly assigns the value -1.481 to the blue line ('美国学者') at '第二维度'. The correct value shown on the chart is 1.481.
The description incorrectly assigns the value -1.328 to the blue line ('美国学者') at '第三维度'. The correct value shown on the chart is 1.328.
The description incorrectly assigns the value -0.466 to the blue line ('美国学者') at '第五维度'. The correct value shown on the chart is 0.466.
The description incorrectly assigns the value -0.180 to the blue line ('美国学者') at '第六维度'. The correct value shown on the chart is 0.180.
The description for the red line fails to mention that it also has circular markers, while it correctly identifies them for the blue line ('带圆点标记').
